title: Accelerated indirect photolysis of UV-328 within the hydrophobic microdomains of dissolved organic matter: the role of sorption and localized reactive intermediates
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1385-1395
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00139D, Paper
Mingzhu He, Zhansheng Li, Hongxia Zhao, Yuhong Su, Shafiul Azam, Jiawen Shao
UV-328 is strongly partitioned into DOM hydrophobic microdomains, where locally concentrated 3DOM* and 1O2 accelerate its indirect photolysis; the photoproducts formed via hydrolysis, bond cleavage and hydroxylation show lower ecotoxicity.
